Description

Bustling workshop of clanging metal and forge-fire glow. Walls lined with polished armor and shields. A welcoming hearth in the corner, workbenches cluttered with tools.

Eldric Steelshaper — friendly, hardworking, always happy to advise on gear

Services & Wares

  • Specializes in common and uncommon magical armor
  • Adamantine Armor, Sentinel Shield, Serpent Scale Armor
  • Shield of the Tortoise, Boomerang Shield
  • Custom armor commissions

Reputation

Known for reliable, quality armor work. Adventurers seeking dependable gear make this their first stop in Ardenville.
